reading: Failed payment captures should be retried automatically up to three times, then flagged for manual review.

requirements.text: Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff
requirements.evidence: capture() loops three times with a doubling delay.

requirements.text: Each retry carries the same idempotency key
requirements.evidence: The key is created once before the loop.

requirements.text: After the last failure the order is flagged for manual review
requirements.evidence: No code in the diff sets the order flag after the final attempt.

outOfScope.note: Banner styling is not part of the ticket.
